brief: The burning-ground grove at night: the Vetāla seated on a root rubbing his hands; a tiny round spirit of old paper in round spectacles with scrolls under both arms and one finger wagging at the sky; Dādī and Śuka beside you; a faint image in the smoke of a king and a hungry beggar on a lane.
